active_domain.name: Black Rainbow Closed Mathematical Landscape

presentation_handoff.law: H changes local orientation/readout; H^2 returns local presentation class while retained History may differ.

active_domain.interpretation_guard: Black Rainbow is the project closed mathematical landscape; Rainbow Road/Mobius supplies recursive runtime/carrier structure. This is not an external physical-universe claim.
active_domain.dependency_chain_policy: A chain is an ordered history-bearing QMO. If its terminal state is CLOSED_FIXED_POINT and all declared subdomain closure obligations pass, the same QMO address may be registered as a closed subdomain; open/forked chains remain objects but not domains.
active_domain.bounded_iteration_policy: Every iterative query declares a finite horizon N and stop predicates. Results remain in the Black Rainbow landscape or terminate as a domain-boundary condition; no unbounded generative escape is licensed.

semantic_state.closure_condition: Cl_BR(X) ~= X under current Black Rainbow domain equivalence
semantic_state.history_condition: History may append even when the semantic object set is at closure.
semantic_state.iteration_condition: Bounded recursion may run to N but terminates early on target recovery, fixed-point closure, fork/cycle/defect, exhausted admissibility, or domain boundary.
